description: A document related to dependent or child care expenses, such as a daycare invoice, tuition statement, or in-home care payment receipt. Used to verify dependent-care household expenses.

provider_name.instruction: The name of the daycare, child care center, or in-home care provider.

provider_address.instruction: The address of the dependent-care provider.

dependent_name.instruction: The full name of the child or dependent receiving care.

care_period_start.instruction: Start of the care period covered by this statement. YYYY-MM-DD format.

care_period_end.instruction: End of the care period covered by this statement. YYYY-MM-DD format.

rate_amount.instruction: The rate charged for care, such as a weekly or monthly amount.

payment_frequency.instruction: Frequency of the care payment, such as weekly, biweekly, or monthly.

document_type.instruction: Type of dependent-care document, such as invoice, tuition statement, or payment receipt.

statement_date.instruction: Date the invoice or statement was issued. YYYY-MM-DD format.

amount_paid.instruction: Amount already paid toward the dependent-care expense, if stated.

balance_due.instruction: Remaining balance due for the dependent-care expense, if stated.
